description: This file is a test script for Git checkout paths, using shell commands and testing framework functions to verify repository state changes during checkout operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and checks the test condition.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timer placeholder used for timestamp consistency.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for equality, used to verify expected vs actual results.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a particular path exists as a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a particular path is missing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_tool chmtime
methods.description: Custom tool for changing or getting file modification times.
